Name: Cozy Chocolate Furniture
Author: skellady
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/wjvBU12.png[/img]﻿

 [/center]

[img]https://imgur.com/Jl1E0ek.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]This mod adds 100+ furniture pieces through Content Patcher. You can find the furniture in the Cozy Chocolate catalogue, which can be bought from Robin's store for [b][color=#e69138]100,000 gold[/color][/b] (configurable). You can also search for [b]"[color=#e69138]skellady[/color]"[/b] in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] to find the furniture if you don't want to buy the catalogue.

This set contains couches, armchairs, tables, wall length windows, small decorations, and more!

You can check out the following mods if you'd like a kitchen and some flooring/wallpaper to match:
[/size][size=3]
- Cozy Chocolate Kitchen
- Cozy Chocolate Walls and Floors

Disclaimer: The TVs added by this mod are decorative and do NOT function. Just have a normal TV and a decorative one if you really want to decorate with the one added here.

Farmhouse used in the screenshot is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16438]Aimon's Tidy Cozy Farmhouse[/url].
[/size][b]
[/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/cmP0vay.png[/img]﻿
[size=3]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url].
2. Install this mod.
3. Extract all and drop them into your Mods folder.[/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/OYwortt.png[/img]
